{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:20}|%|]{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive:{/c} Enemies that attack you are Poisoned for {c_number}{dot:POISON_DOT}{/c} damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:POISON_DOT}]{/c} seconds.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Your toxins overflow, applying the Poisoning in a trail and making you {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:TIMER}|1|]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Toxic Skin{/c} generates {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} Vigor per second while active.
{c_important}Toxic Skin{/c} passively increases your Thorns by {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%x|]{/c}.
While {c_important}Toxic Skin{/c} is active, Heal for {c_number}[SF_18*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_18]){/c} per second.

While {c_important}Toxic Skin{/c} is active, you launch toxic globs that apply {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_A_POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_POISON_DOT}]{/c} seconds

{c_important}Toxic Skin's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[SF_29]{/c} |4second:seconds; and its damage {c_important}{u}Weakens{/u}{/c} enemies. While its active, you gain {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} Armor.

{c_important}Toxic Skin{/c} becomes a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill that deals Fire damage. 

{c_label}Passive:{/c} Whenever you receive Healing, gain {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage until your next Critical Strike, up to {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%+|]{/c}.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Jaguar energy flows through you, automatically slashing Close enemies for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE}{/c} damage every {c_number}[{SF_27}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds; for {c_number}[{buffduration:TIMER}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
